text:
Maggie (Sales): Hey team — PocketBank (POC) just asked for a minimal compliance bundle to proceed: SOC 2 artifacts, ISO cert + scope, and a signed pen-test letter. They want this before kickoff. @Noah (Security) @Oliver (Eng) any quick constraints or blockers?
Noah (Security): We can provide: SOC 2 Type II summary (redacted), control mapping spreadsheet (redacted), ISO 27001 certificate + scope doc. We do NOT share raw penetration reports; we provide a signed attestation/letter instead.
Oliver (Eng): For technical artifacts we can drop a staged network diagram and an architecture snapshot (no internal IPs). If they ask for KMS flows we can provide an anonymized keyflow diagram. Nothing that reveals internal hostnames or performance telemetry.
Maggie (Sales): Great. Timeline? PocketBank wants the bundle within 48 hours if possible. Is that realistic?
Noah (Security): 48h for the redacted SOC2 summary + ISO cert if we have the files in our vault. Pen-test letter depends — legal needs customer info + signatory. Plan 2-5 business days to get a signed vendor letter if legal stamp needed.
Tara (Presales): I can prep the pen-test letter template and route to legal. To speed up: can Maggie collect the following from the customer?
Tara (Presales): ```
Required from customer to request signed evidence:
- Legal entity name (for the letter)
- Contact name + email for NDA/attestation
- POC start date and estimated duration
- Whether they need SFTP upload or presigned download links
- Any data residency constraints (EU/UK)
```
Maggie (Sales): On it. Quick question: does delivering the bundle or signing the letter trigger extra charges or a delay in POC infra provisioning?
Noah (Security): No extra charges. Only potential delay is waiting on the pen-test vendor signature and legal review. Also if they request non-redacted artifacts we need an executed NDA/information sharing agreement first.
Oliver (Eng): Operational note — if they ask for staging creds we should provide ephemeral creds scoped to the POC project. Provide exact IP ranges if they want allowlisting.
Maggie (Sales): Copy. I'll collect the customer details and ask whether they prefer SFTP vs presigned links. PocketBank contact is: elena.perez@pocketbank.example (will confirm legal name). POC tentative start: next Monday.
Noah (Security): Add one more item to Tara's checklist: confirm whether customer requires vendor attestation format (some banks want a specific phrasing). If so, we'll adapt the letter.
Tara (Presales): Yep — if they have a required template, upload it to the ticket. Otherwise we'll use our standard pen-test attestation.
Maggie (Sales): Created the request and filed it with evidence-bot: request #523. evidence-bot: Evidence request 523 created and queued for Security review. ETA: SOC/ISO artifacts 24-48h, pen-test attestation pending legal sign-off.
evidence-bot: Status update scheduled — reminder to Security in 24h.
Maggie (Sales): I'll follow up once I have Elena's legal entity and whether they need a vendor-specific attestation. Thanks everyone :handshake:
Noah (Security): Thanks — ping me if they want any non-standard language.
Oliver (Eng): I'll prep the anonymized diagrams and a short README for what we're sharing.
Tara (Presales): I'll draft the letter and start the legal flow once Maggie confirms the legal contact.
